skill.name: agentuity-cli-cloud-secret-push
skill.description: Push secrets from local .env file to cloud. Requires authentication. Use for Agentuity cloud platform operations
skill.body:
# Cloud Secret Push

Push secrets from local .env file to cloud

## Prerequisites

- Authenticated with `agentuity auth login`
- Project context required (run from project directory or use `--project-id`)
- secret set

## Usage

```bash
agentuity cloud secret push
```

## Examples

Run push command:

```bash
bunx @agentuity/cli secret push
```

## Output

Returns JSON object:

```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "pushed": "number",
  "source": "string"
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Whether push succeeded |
| `pushed` | number | Number of items pushed |
| `source` | string | Source file path |

generated_query: I'm working on an Agentuity cloud project and have just updated my local `.env` file with several new API keys and database credentials. I need to securely push these secrets to the cloud so my deployed functions can use them. I already authenticated earlier, and I'm currently in the project directory. Could you walk me through the command to push the secrets and then tell me how many were successfully uploaded, along with the source file path?
